clinical_definitions.NORMAL_BONE_RADIOGRAPH: Normal skeletal bone radiograph with intact cortical margin and physiological trabecular pattern
clinical_definitions.BENIGN_BONE_TUMOR: Benign primary bone tumour (e.g. osteochondroma, enchondroma, non-ossifying fibroma, giant cell tumour)
clinical_definitions.PRIMARY_MALIGNANT_TUMOR: Primary malignant bone sarcoma (e.g. osteosarcoma, chondrosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma)
